OK: In Gen3 the PID and Individual Values share the same source (Method 1 random algorithm), so shiny, nature, Individual Values and gender cannot all hold at the same time. When they conflict, the program gives way step by step in the order below: items further up are kept first, items further down are sacrificed first.
确定: Gen3 的 PID 与个体值同源（Method 1 随机算法），闪光、性格、个体值、性别这四项在数学上无法全部同时成立。发生冲突时，程序会按下面的顺序逐级让步：越靠前的项目优先保留，靠后的先被牺牲。

OK: · Individual Values (IV): the 6 stat values. Maxing them usually conflicts with the nature.
确定: · 个体值：即 IV，6 项能力值。刷满个体值时通常与性格冲突。

OK: · Gender: derived from the PID, the easiest to give up.
确定: · 性别：由 PID 派生，最容易让步。

OK: · Nature: in Gen3 the nature is determined by the PID (PID % 25), affecting stats and nature modifiers.
确定: · 性格：Gen3 性格由 PID 决定（PID % 25），会影响能力与性格修正。

OK: · Max IVs: all 6 are set to 31 directly and take no part in the trade-off; a matching PID is then looked for, and the nature may change (the set of candidate natures for all-31 IVs is fixed).
确定: · 满个体值：6 项直接拉满 31，不参与取舍；随后会尽量找一个与之配套的 PID，此时性格可能改变（全 31 对应的候选性格是固定的）。

OK: · Reroll PID: a new PID is generated and the Individual Values change with it. Items listed before "Individual Values" in this list are kept (e.g. with Nature→Shiny→IV→Gender, nature and shiny are kept).
确定: · 重掷 PID：随机一个新 PID，个体值随之变化。排在这个列表里「个体值之前」的项目会被保住（例如 性格→闪光→个体值→性别 时，保住性格与闪光）。

OK: · Shiny: a shiny individual, with a hit rate of roughly 1/4096.
确定: · 闪光：异色个体，命中率约 1/4096。

OK: · Randomize IVs: a random set of Individual Values is generated and the PID follows it, keeping the same items listed before "Individual Values".
确定: · 随机个体值：随机一组个体值，再让 PID 跟着它走，同样保住「个体值之前」的项目。
